name: Ebihara Urara
source:
She grew up in a relatively wealthy family and is a somewhat naive and unworldly young lady.

She will be transferring to Kurodo Academy from the second semester to pay off the debts of her fiancé, for whom she was a guarantor.

She has an unconventional idea that "your first time should be given to your future spouse on the wedding night."

For a long time, she has had the urge to urinate when she gets nervous or excited, and in some situations she wets herself.
